SpellcastingNature (a divine tradition). Wisdom is the casting stat. DC = 10 + half your Druid level (minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier — see Spellcasting in Arneyan for the full formula.

Level by Level at a Glance

What you gain and when. Full details are under Class Abilities.

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Bonus Language

  • Effect: Gain the secret druidic tongue — forbidden to teach to non-druids.
  • High Intelligence also unlocks: Elvish, Giant, Gnomish, Primordial, Sylvan

Nature Lore (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Identify plants and animals perfectly within the Druid's trained region.
  • Determine if water is safe to drink
  • Find basic shelter and enough food for one person automatically
  • Feeding additional people takes 6 hours of foraging and a Moderate Wisdom (Survival) check, and feeds an extra 2d4 people
  • Unfamiliar regions require a Wisdom check for all of the above

Wild Shape

  • Effect: Shapeshift into any beast or beast-like monster of Level no greater than half your Druid level, rounded down (minimum Level 1), once per day, choosing the form fresh each time (any beast in Monsters & Treasure, or one of these beast-like monsters: Owlbear, Death Dog, Hippogriff, Griffon, Ankheg, Bulette, Carrion Crawler, Grick, Grick Alpha, Hook Horror, Young Remorhaz, Hydra, Piercer and Rust Monster; others at the GM's call, but never a solo, an intelligent or a magical creature).
  • Lasts up to 1 hour or until you choose to revert.
  • You take the form's whole stat block from Monsters & Treasure: its HP, AC, attacks, saves and movement.
  • You keep your own mind, personality and Wisdom-based abilities, and you cannot cast spells in a form that cannot speak.
  • When the form drops to 0 HP you return to your own form with the HP you had when you changed (see Changing Shape in Spellcasting in Arneyan).
  • 3rd level: usable twice per day
  • 6th level: usable three times per day
  • 9th level: usable four times per day
  • 15th level: usable five times per day
  • 24th level: usable six times per day

2nd Level

Resist Elements

  • Effect: Advantage on saves vs fire, water, earth, air, cold, and lightning attacks.

3rd Level

Woodland Stride

  • Effect: Move through natural difficult terrain — thorns, briars, overgrowth — at full speed with no damage or impairment, leaving no trail.
  • Magically manipulated terrain still impedes normally

12th Level

Deepened Shape

  • Effect: Your Wild Shape Level cap rises to your full Druid level instead of half (so a 12th-level Druid can become any beast or monster of Level 12 or lower). Shifting also now grants temporary HP equal to twice your Druid level, lasting until the shift ends or the temp HP is depleted.

13th Level

Advanced Nature Lore

  • Effect: Nature Lore now extends to a second region or regional type, fully functional including foraging.
  • Extends to a third region at 21st level

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

Wild Shape Casting

  • Effect: While in Wild Shape, you may cast spells from your prepared list that have only verbal or no components.
  • Spells requiring somatic components cannot be cast while shifted
  • Your Wisdom modifier applies normally to all spells cast in this way

18th Level

Dismiss Woodland Creatures (Wisdom)

  • Effect: Dismiss any animal, beast, plant, or vermin native to one of the Druid's Nature Lore regions.
  • Wisdom check, DC = 10 + total Levels of the creatures being dismissed
  • Each day the Druid can dismiss Levels worth of creatures equal to 10 + Wisdom modifier without penalty
  • Dismissed creatures flee and don't return until the Druid departs

20th Level

Perfect Recall

  • Effect: Recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot.
  • Scales at 24th level: now works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

Elemental Mastery

  • Effect: Choose one element — fire, cold, lightning, earth, water, or air. The Druid is immune to its damage entirely.
  • When struck by a spell of that element, make a Wisdom check against the spell's save DC
  • Succeed on the check: the spell is reflected back at a target of the Druid's choice for its original damage

21st Level

Language of the Wilderlands

  • Effect: Communicate with any bird, beast, tree, or growing thing via their natural method — sound, motion, communion.
  • Most creatures have limited understanding — expect simple impressions, not tactical reports

24th Level

Awaken Woodland Spirit

  • Effect: Spend several days with a plant or animal to fully awaken it — grants human-level consciousness, speech in the Druid's tongue, two extra HD, maximum HP, and +2 to AC, damage, and saves.
  • The awakened creature remains loyal to the Druid for life
  • Maximum awakened HD at any time = twice your Druid level

Kits: Druidic Circles

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Druid folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Druid Kits represent which circle a Druid was trained in. The Cabal is an overarching druidic organisation with multiple regional circles, each led by a Hierophant. Mournas has its own independent circle separate from the Cabal's structure.

Druid Spell List

Spells available to the Druid, by level. * = reversible spell. ‡ = needs a costed material component (see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue). Full descriptions, saves and components are in Spellcasting in Arneyan.

Spells Per Day

  • Bonus Spells: Wisdom 13–15 grants an extra 1st level spell, 16–17 an extra 2nd level spell, 18+ an extra 3rd level spell. Cumulative, and only acquired once the Druid is high enough level to cast that tier.
